To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the Twitter API is a valuable source of information for emergency management; 2) the use of a machine learning algorithm for identifying relevant tweets is a promising approach for emergency management; and 3) the ESA-AWTM system can provide a useful tool for emergency managers to improve situation awareness.

Twitter can be used to provide a valuable source of information for crisis coordination; and the ESA-AWTM platform and tools can be used by emergency management agencies to provide situation awareness to their staff, to support the management of emergency incidents.
Twitter is an effective medium for disseminating messages of interest in a crisis, but it is not an effective medium for receiving and responding to messages of interest in crisis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of a system that automatically identifies and summarises relevant Twitter messages in near real time to assist emergency responders in their decision-making processes.
how the information available on Twitter can be used to improve situational awareness during a crisis.
how the information in social media can be automatically analysed, filtered, and presented in a manner that supports decision making by emergency management personnel.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ESA-AWTM system is a useful tool for the detection of relevant messages from Twitter, and the summarisation and reporting of such messages for emergency situation awareness.
the ESA-AWTM system has demonstrated its capability to detect and summarise relevant Twitter messages in real time.
ESA-AWTM has been successfully developed and is capable of providing the required information to emergency managers and other stakeholders.

Twitter can be an effective source of information for emergency management, but it is not the sole solution to all problems.
the ESA-AWTM system is a novel approach to the problem of emergency incident situation awareness from Twitter.
